crossRefs.note: Why is your clothing red, and your garments like him who treads in the wine vat?

translations.web: Why is your clothing red, and your garments like him who treads in the wine vat?
translations.bsb: Why are Your clothes red, and Your garments like one who treads the winepress?
translations.kjv: Wherefore art thou red in thine apparel, and thy garments like him that treadeth in the winefat?
translations.asv: Wherefore art thou red in thine apparel, and thy garments like him that treadeth in the winevat?
